title: Disagreement under coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ take values in $\{-1,1\}$, and let $J\subseteq[n]$. The uniform expectation over $z\in\{0,1\}^n$ of the disagreement probability between $f$ and the function $x\mapsto f(x_J,z_{[n]\setminus J})$ is $\displaystyle\frac12\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\mathbf{1}_{\{S\nsubseteq J\}}\widehat f(S)^2$, where $x_J,z_{[n]\setminus J}$ denotes the point equal to $x$ on $J$ and to $z$ elsewhere.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $J\subseteq[n]$. For uniform independent $z$ and $x$, and $x\star_Jz$ keeping $x$ on $J$ and $z$ elsewhere, $\mathbb E_z\Pr_x(f(x)\ne f(x\star_Jz))=\tfrac12\sum_{S\nsubseteq J}\widehat f(S)^2$.
